$comment: TEST FIXTURE — deliberately invalid. The letter on a rule id says which kind of rule it is: P is evaluated once per product, I once per interface, G once per entry in a group. This fixture puts a rule numbered I1 in productRules and a rule numbered P1 in interfaceRules, and gives a group member an id that does not sit under its group. C16 must fail. Not a real profile; do not copy.
